\section{From the \texorpdfstring{$\Theta$}{Theta}-link to bounded discrepancy}

The $\Theta$-link and the bounded-discrepancy graph do not terminate at the same
carrier state.  That difference is useful.  The engaging $\Theta$-link calculation
reaches $A=\{T,F,t,f\}$, whose classical slice is $B$.  The bounded-discrepancy
calculation reaches $Ftf=\{F,t,f\}$, whose classical slice is $F$.  The second is not a
weaker copy of the first.  It is a different information state produced by a
different graph.

What persists is the form of the computation:
\[
\begin{aligned}
\text{source}&\longrightarrow\text{split}\longrightarrow\text{asymmetric work}
\longrightarrow\text{engagement}\\
&\longrightarrow\text{fixation}\longrightarrow\text{fuse}\longrightarrow\text{readout}.
\end{aligned}
\]
At no point does this form require every intermediate value to belong to
$\{F,T\}$.  Indeed, the extension $\eta$ is specifically an operation whose purpose is
to retain the information layer.  A Boolean restriction would have to delete the
operation's result in order to remain classical.

This is the IUT computation in the branch calculus.  The theory moves through alien
structures, preserves specified invariants across controlled indeterminacy, and
terminates in an ordered arithmetic bound.  In conventional notation this act is: decompose the object,
let the arms acquire asymmetric information, rejoin them, retain the
contradictory/nonclassical content, and read out a bound-bearing state.

\section{Why the final inequality is not a return to classicality}

It would be a mistake to treat the final real-valued inequality as evidence that
the construction has finally returned to a Boolean restriction.  A numerical
inequality can be the readout of a nonclassical computation.  The codomain of the
last scalar estimate does not retroactively determine the carrier of
the transformations that produced it.

This is already visible in the bounded-discrepancy calculation.  The terminal readout is the
``logarithmic bound,'' yet the carrier state at that anchor is $Ftf$, not $T$ or $F$.
The graph can therefore end at a perfectly definite inequality while retaining
non-Boolean information about how that inequality was obtained.

Likewise, IUT's Diophantine conclusion does not imply that all of the
inter-universal transport preceding it can be represented inside the Boolean
restriction.  The final bound is a scalar shadow of a richer construction.  The
shadow can be classical even when the carrier that casts it is not.

\section{Species, mutation, and realization independence}

Paper IV's species language extends the same principle at the set-theoretic end
of the theory \cite{iut4}.  A species gives formulas that determine a category in
different realizations; mutations transport the presentation; cores are
what survive the mutation.  The emphasis is again on invariance across changes
of realization rather than identity of all realization-level presentations.

The same labeled directed graph can be realized in different mathematical
contexts while its incidence structure, closure predicates, and admissible
transformations remain meaningful.  This variation of realization does not
vary the logical base.  Every realization remains subject to the same
non-explosive consequence relation and the same full carrier; realization
independence is therefore not permission to return to a Boolean foundation.  Its type is carried by organized relations,
not by a demand that every realization share one literal underlying object.
Self-reference is carried by ordinary endomorphisms such as
$\operatorname{id}:\mathcal X\to\mathcal X$ without licensing explosion.

This realization-independence is structural and occurs within the rebased logical substrate.  The graph may contain
maps that act on its own retained data, and those self-referential motions remain
subject to exactly the same incidence and carrier laws as every other motion in
the calculation.

The consequences can be stated directly.  Applying a Boolean restriction to the
full carrier destroys at least five kinds of information used in the
structure developed above:
\begin{enumerate}
\item It identifies $N$ and $B$ under either canonical collapse, although one is
incomplete and the other inconsistent.
\item It replaces a contradictory fixed point by one of two opposite classical
poles.
\item It removes the $t,f$ information layer from full sixteen-state carrier values
such as $Ftf$ and $A$.
\item It cannot represent the extension $\eta$ as an operation whose output remains
inside the classical carrier.
\item It encourages a single verdict where the graph actually carries several
simultaneous properties: reconnection, phase, terminal carrier state, unfilled ports,
and invariant content.
\end{enumerate}
These are not cosmetic losses.  They remove exactly the information needed to

\section{Scholze--Stix and the vacuity produced by tensor-blind comparison}
\label{sec:ss-vacuity}

The Scholze--Stix objection must be stated at full strength.  Their analysis of
the passage to IUT III, Corollary 3.12 argues that the $j^2$ factors attached to
the concrete $\Theta$-pilot data cannot be retained while simultaneously making
what they regard as consistent identifications among the ordered real lines in
which the corresponding pilot quantities are represented.  Removing those
factors yields an inequality of the form
\[
  0 \;\lesssim\; d(P),
\]
which they describe as essentially free of content; under the same
simplifications, they remark that the relevant multiradial theorem becomes
``not false, but trivial'' \cite{ss2018}.

The tensor filtration does not answer this by introducing a quotient, a collapse,
or a hidden identification.  There is no such operation.  The relevant object
is a \emph{tensor filtration}.  The procession of tensor packets of log-shells
is retained as a filtered object, and the weights occurring at different
tensor positions are read at the positions at which they occur.  Schematically,
write
\[
  0\subseteq F_0\mathcal T\subseteq F_1\mathcal T
  \subseteq\cdots\subseteq F_m\mathcal T=\mathcal T
\]
for the tensor filtration of the common container.  What matters is not a
single scalar line on which every $j$-label must act by the same normalization,
but the tensor packet together with the filtration position at which each
contribution occurs.  We may record that position by the filtration degree
\[
  \nu_F(x):=\min\{j:x\in F_j\mathcal T\}.
\]
Thus the $j^2$-weight is not an extra scalar inserted into one universal real
line.  It is indexed by the position $j$ of the contribution in the tensor
filtration:
\[
  \nu_F(x)=j
  \qquad\Longrightarrow\qquad
  \text{the corresponding $\Theta$-contribution carries weight }j^2.
\]
Different $j^2$-weights at different filtration positions do not constitute
monodromy of one scalar line.  They are the filtration data.

This is precisely why the Scholze--Stix scalar diagram and the IUT tensor
calculation ask different questions.  Scholze--Stix require the various
real-valued representatives to participate in one simultaneous system of
identifications and then diagnose the $j^2$-dependence as an inconsistency in
that system \cite{ss2018}.  But IUT III performs the multiradial representation
on regions inside tensor packets of log-shells and only afterwards forms the
log-volume of the resulting holomorphic hull \cite{iut3}.  The tensor packet is
not decorative bookkeeping around an underlying one-dimensional comparison;
it is where the comparison lives.

\subsection{Mochizuki's reply, and where it stops short}
\label{subsec:mochizuki-ss}

Mochizuki's published response correctly identifies a real defect in the
Scholze--Stix surrogate diagram.  In his comments on their manuscript he states
that the proof of IUT III, Corollary 3.12 does not require the simultaneous
identification of the various copies of $\mathbb R$, does not identify the
$\Theta$- and $q$-side scalar objects in the manner drawn by Scholze--Stix, and
does not contain the commuting loop on which their monodromy argument is based
\cite{mochizukiCmt2018}.  His report on the March discussions makes the same
point geometrically: identifying the two endpoints of a segment creates a loop,
and the incompatibility of the $\Theta$-link with arithmetic degree may then
appear as nontrivial monodromy; IUT instead keeps the domain and codomain
distinct \cite{mochizukiRpt2018}.

That answer is important, but it is not the strongest answer available.  From
the logical base of the present paper, Mochizuki's response still grants too
much to the classical criterion that generated the objection.  He describes
the incompatibility produced by the loop as a ``contradiction'' that is
\emph{avoided} by distinguishing the two sides.  Distinguishing the sides is
mathematically correct; treating the avoidance of contradiction as the
foundational reason for doing so is not.

The distinction of labels has a more precise role.  It preserves locality:
different ring structures, filtration positions, and transport histories remain
different data.  It need not guarantee that every readout formed from those data
is classically consistent.  If a local comparison carries both a determination
and an incompatible determination, that state remains a legitimate state of the
calculation.  What is forbidden is unrestricted explosion, not contradiction
itself.

This gives two residual misunderstandings in Mochizuki's response, relative to
the rebase developed here.

\begin{enumerate}
\item \textbf{The avoidance misunderstanding.}
  The role of distinct labels is described as preventing a contradiction from
  arising.  Here their role is instead to prevent the \emph{loss of locality}.
  Contradictory information may remain live after locality has been preserved.

\item \textbf{The scalar-stage misunderstanding.}
  Mochizuki answers the Scholze--Stix loop mainly by denying that the loop occurs
  in the proof and by appealing to the single log-volume on the common
  multiradial container.  That is true as a description of his construction,
  but it does not isolate the decisive defect in the Scholze--Stix reduction:
  their scalar diagram has already forgotten the tensor-filtration position at
  which the $j^2$ weights live.  The stronger objection is therefore not merely
  ``your loop is not my diagram''.  It is ``your scalar diagram is not a
  faithful readout of the filtered tensor object''.
\end{enumerate}

The resulting answer to Scholze--Stix is therefore stronger than Mochizuki's
published answer without contradicting its valid structural point.  The
$\Theta$-side and $q$-side should indeed remain distinct.  But even if one
constructs an auxiliary comparison in which incompatible scalar determinations
appear, the mere presence of that incompatibility is not a proof-theoretic
failure.  To obtain a substantive objection one must show either that the
filtered tensor data cannot be formed as stated, or that the final readout
requires an explosive inference from the incompatible state.  The
Scholze--Stix scalar vacuity argument establishes neither.

The point may be isolated formally.

\begin{proposition}[Filtered non-vacuity]
Let $\mathcal T$ be a filtered tensor object and suppose a numerical estimate
depends on weights $w_j$ carried at filtration positions $F_j\mathcal T$.  If
one replaces the filtered readout by a readout that is insensitive to the
filtration index $j$, then the resulting estimate may become tautological even
though the filtered estimate is not.  The tautology of the tensor-blind readout
does not imply the tautology of the filtered estimate.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proof}
A $j$-insensitive readout factors all terms through data on which the distinction
between $w_j$ and $w_k$ is unavailable.  Any contribution depending on that
distinction is therefore absent from the resulting scalar expression.  No
inverse inference from the scalar expression to the filtered expression is
available unless the readout is proved faithful to the filtration.  Hence
triviality after suppressing the filtration is compatible with nontriviality
before that suppression.
\end{proof}

This proposition does not establish Corollary 3.12 by itself.  It identifies the
burden that a non-vacuous objection must meet.  To refute the IUT inequality on
this point, one must work inside the tensor filtration actually used by the
multiradial representation and show that the $j^2$-weighted information fails
there.  Demonstrating that the inequality becomes empty after passing to a
tensor-blind scalar comparison establishes the emptiness of that comparison.
It does not establish the emptiness of the filtered tensor calculation.

This also explains why the word ``identification'' is dangerous in this
discussion.  The $\Theta$-side and the $q$-side need not be made into one common
ring, and the tensor positions need not be made into one common scalar stage.
The common container supplies comparability by filtration.  It does not require
the differences that generate the estimate to disappear before they are
measured.  In the language developed throughout this paper, the information is
carried through the relation rather than normalized away prior to the readout.

Four supplied Lean files are used only as certificates for the structural
statements explicitly proved in them.  In each case the theorem relevant here
has the form
\[
\mu(x,x)=x.
\]
The files are
\begin{description}[style=nextline,leftmargin=0pt,labelindent=0pt]
\item[\path{iutclosedwalkatoinfinity_gate_check.lean}]
recoverability with separate truth/falsity restrictions;
\item[\path{glattfelderselfcontainmentprinciple_gate_check.lean}]
independent occurrence of the same self-fusion law;
\item[\path{kastrupconformalgroup_gate_check.lean}]
independent occurrence of the same self-fusion law;
\item[\path{scholzestixbooleanprojectionato2_gate_check.lean}]
Boolean projection represented only after a richer internal calculation.
\end{description}
Comments in those files concerning class names, expected tiers, periods, or
semantic labels are treated as annotations rather than as proved theorems.  The
certificates clarify the algebraic shape of the construction; they do not
replace a proof of the number-theoretic statements of IUT.

\section{Operational commitments}

The paper fixes concrete mathematical obligations.  The $\Theta$-link must be
specified by its directed edges and branch/recombination relation, not inferred from
the order in which formulas are printed.  Carrier values must be produced by the
maps defined on
\[
\mathcal X=\mathcal P(\{T,F,t,f\}).
\]
If $C_{12}=\langle R\rangle$ acts on the presentation, quantities declared invariant
must be constant on the $C_{12}$-orbit; quantities that vary with $R^k$ are phase-bearing.
Tensor weights remain attached to their filtration positions until the
bounded-discrepancy readout is formed.

These obligations are checkable.  A claimed reconnection fails when the
directed graph does not supply the required common ancestry.  A claimed
invariant fails when $R$ changes it.  A claimed frame-retention property fails when the
orbit exposes a cut at which it is absent.  A claimed $B$, $Ftf$, or $A$ state
fails when the carrier state does not contain the corresponding atoms.  A
claimed bounded-discrepancy filtration fails if the $j^2$-weighted contribution
is absent at the filtration position where the calculation requires it.

Non-explosion does not relax any of these conditions.  It prevents an admitted
contradiction from entailing arbitrary statements; it does not license an
incorrect edge, carrier value, reconnection pair, phase invariant, tensor
weight, or arithmetic bound.  The stated graph and carrier laws remain in
force throughout.

\section{Conclusion}

The construction developed here is a rebased logical calculation, not a
reinterpretation of a classical one.  Its continuous directed graph carries
source, partition, branchwise transformation, information retention, fixation,
fusion, carrier motion, phase, closure, and terminal readout.  Its carrier is
\[
\mathcal X=\mathcal P(\{T,F,t,f\}),
\]
with FOUR as a four-state slice and the Boolean pair $\{F,T\}$ as a further
restriction.  Reflection and coreflection remove the nonclassical states in
opposite directions, while the information closure retains contradiction at
$B$.  Classicalization is therefore a loss operation performed after the richer
state already exists.

The four IUT papers move through this same mathematical structure.  The
$\Theta$-link transports data between alien ring structures without identifying
them as one ring.  The indeterminacies retain controlled multiplicity.  The
log-$\Theta$ lattice carries several transport directions in one containment
geometry.  Tensor filtration retains the positions of the $j^2$-weighted
contributions through the multiradial calculation.  The terminal arithmetic
statement is a bounded-discrepancy inequality produced after those operations,
not a return to a Boolean foundation.

The worked calculations make this concrete.  The engaging $\Theta$-link reaches
\[
A=\{T,F,t,f\}.
\]
The bounded-discrepancy graph satisfies its transformed reconnection predicate
and terminates at
\[
Ftf=\{F,t,f\}.
\]
The cyclic shift $R$ leaves the structural predicates invariant while moving
phase-bearing observables.  These are simultaneous properties of one directed
graph and do not require resolution into a single classical pole.

The Scholze--Stix vacuity result occurs only after the filtration position of the

tensor filtration, that position remains part of the datum.  A vacuous

inequality from which the positional information was omitted.

The resulting formulation uses ordinary maps, graph predicates, carrier states,

the rebased calculation is displayed.  Contradiction is
retained without explosion, tensor position is retained without scalar

calculation has run.

# Review: `iutt_fully_conventional.tex` and `manuscripts/opi_finite_size_convergence.tex`

## FILE 1: `/home/mrnob0dy666/imsgct/ig-docs/iutt_fully_conventional.tex`

**Title/abstract/date markers (item 6):** Title is "Inter-Universal Teichmüller Theory: A Paraconsistent Formulation in Conventional Mathematical Notation," author Lando Mills, `\date{}` is empty (no date). The abstract opens with "This is a rebase of the logical substrate, not a reinterpretation of a prior Boolean construction" — explicit internal language presupposing a prior document. Combined with the filename itself (`iutt_fully_conventional.tex` vs. the sibling `iutt.tex`), this is strong internal evidence that this file is a parallel/alternate-notation rewrite of the same IUT material covered in `iutt.tex`, produced specifically to restate the same claims "without an operator inventory" (explicit phrase, Section 4: "The supplied Θ-link calculation can be written without an operator inventory"). It should be flagged to the other reviewer as a likely duplicate/derivative draft of the same underlying content, not an independent paper.

**1. Central claim / strength re: ABC.** The paper does **not** claim to prove, or contribute new mathematical content toward, the ABC conjecture. It is a reformulation of the *logical scaffolding* around Mochizuki's IUT papers I–IV using a 16-valued "paraconsistent" carrier `X = P({T,F,t,f})` (extending Belnap–Dunn FOUR) plus toy category-theoretic maps (reflector/coreflector/closure). Its actual assertions are: (a) a Boolean two-valued semantics cannot faithfully represent a paraconsistent closure operator's fixed point (a genuinely trivial fact, proved in ~4 lines); (b) a rhetorical argument that Mochizuki's published rebuttal to Scholze–Stix "grants too much" and that a "stronger" answer is available if one insists filtration/tensor position data are retained rather than collapsed to a scalar; and (c) several toy "worked calculations" (`Θ-link`, "bounded-discrepancy calculation") expressed as compositions of unspecified abstract maps `f, ℓ, g_T, g_I, g_F` on the 16-element carrier, whose claimed output traces (e.g. `N→N→T→T→N→F→F→Ftf→⋯→Ftf`) are simply *asserted* as "the supplied calculation" — no concrete arithmetic content (heights, log-differentials, actual Frobenioid/Θ-link data) is ever given to justify why the trace takes those particular values. The paper itself explicitly disclaims deciding the Scholze–Stix dispute ("This formal model is not a formalization of the Scholze–Stix manuscript, so it cannot by itself decide their historical objection," §8.1) and disclaims proving IUT's number-theoretic content ("The certificates clarify the algebraic shape of the construction; they do not replace a proof of the number-theoretic statements of IUT," §11). Net assessment: this is **not a proof, not a conditional result, and not new evidence bearing on ABC** — it is a structural/rhetorical relabeling exercise plus a handful of essentially content-free abstract-nonsense lemmas about 4- and 16-element lattices, dressed with heavy IUT vocabulary and Θ-link/log-lattice diagrams that do not touch the actual arithmetic geometry.

**2. Structural completeness.** Abstract does state the central distinction (rebase vs. reinterpretation) but is notation-heavy rather than pure prose. Has genuine numbered theorem/proposition/observation environments (`Boolean inexpressibility of the contradictory fixed point`, `The rebase is not a re-description`, `Filtered non-vacuity`) each followed by a short but real prose proof with displayed steps — these particular proofs are legitimate, if elementary. However, the paper's *substantive* IUT-related claims (the Θ-link trace, the bounded-discrepancy trace, `C_rec=1`, `C_walk^(11)=0`, entropy `ΔS≈0`) are never proved — they are reported as outputs of an unseen "supplied calculation"/Lean file. The Conclusion section restates the construction confidently but does not include an explicit "what remains open" statement (the disclaimers about not deciding Scholze–Stix / not proving IUT's number theory are buried in §8.1 and §11, not restated at the end). Bibliography: yes, includes genuine primary literature (Belnap, Dunn, Mochizuki I–IV, Mochizuki's comments/report, Scholze–Stix), plus one self-citation `\bibitem{uno}` to "C. Lando Mills, *UNO Reverse*, August 31, 2026" — an internal, non-primary-literature self-reference.

**3. House-style violations (file paths / Lean identifiers / dev-narrative).** Clear violations, concentrated in §"Formal certificates used in this paper" (`sec:gatecheck-status`) and its preceding subsections:
- Literal Lean file paths via `\path{}`:
  > `\item[\path{iutclosedwalkatoinfinity_gate_check.lean}]`
  > `\item[\path{glattfelderselfcontainmentprinciple_gate_check.lean}]`
  > `\item[\path{kastrupconformalgroup_gate_check.lean}]`
  > `\item[\path{scholzestixbooleanprojectionato2_gate_check.lean}]`
- A named Lean object identifier: *"The supplied Lean model named `\texttt{ScholzeStixBooleanProjectionAtO2}` does not begin with a two-state calculation."*
- Metadata narration about the Lean file's internal comments: *"The file also contains comments recording a period, a dialetheia-completeness flag, and an expected tier. Those comments are metadata; the self-fusion identity is the theorem actually proved in the file."* — this both names Lean-codebase metadata fields and narrates what is/isn't "actually proved," which is process-narration about the source artifact rather than the mathematics itself.
- *"The Glattfelder and Kastrup gate-checks supplied alongside it prove the same self-fusion identity for their respective ground objects."* — references external gate-check files by name.

**4. Mathematical gaps.**
- The maps `f, ℓ : X → X` ("context-dependent arithmetic transformations") are never defined concretely anywhere in the file — they are introduced purely as "ordinary maps" and then a specific execution trace through them is asserted (§8.2, "The terminal carrier state is not Boolean"). There is no way to check, from the document alone, that `f(x_T) = T`, `ℓ(π_F(x_F)) = F`, etc., in the claimed trace.
- The "worked calculations" (`Θ-link reaches A={T,F,t,f}`, bounded-discrepancy reaches `Ftf`, `C_rec(G_bd)=1`, `C_walk^{(11)}=0`, `C_walk^{(circuit)}=1`, `ΔS≈0`, the 12-cycle "orbit census: 4 retained + 6 vacuous + 2 exposed") are all numerical/graph-theoretic claims presented as outputs of an unseen external computation ("the supplied calculation," "the supplied entropy report," "the supplied orbit"), with **zero computation shown** in the manuscript. This is exactly the "numerical claims presented without the computation that would back them" failure mode.
- The representative bounded-discrepancy inequality (§9, "Paper IV: bounded discrepancy as executable geometry") uses `ht_{ω_X(D)}`, `log-diff_X`, `log-cond_D` without defining any of these — acceptable as a citation of Mochizuki IV's stated result, but it is asserted rather than derived, and the paper's own abstract maps (`δ_2, ν, π_T, π_F, η, κ, ι, h`) are then claimed to "be" this calculation without an actual correspondence proof connecting the abstract map composition to the cited inequality.
- Figure `fig:cyclic-orbit`'s caption itself concedes an incompleteness: "the remaining ten positions are left unclassified because the supplied data give only their aggregate counts" — an admitted gap in the underlying data being presented as a figure.

**5. LaTeX health.** `\begin{...}`/`\end{...}` counts balance (53/53). All fonts referenced (`Linux Libertine O`, `TeX Gyre Pagella Math`, `Trabajo`) are present on this system, so it should compile with xelatex without font errors. All `\cite{}` keys have matching `\bibitem{}` entries. Only one `\ref` (`fig:bd-circuit`) is actually used despite 22 labels being defined — the other 21 labels (10 section labels, 11 figure/subsection labels) are never referenced anywhere in the text via `\ref`/`\Cref`, which is not a compile error but is a sign of unfinished cross-referencing/editing. No obvious package conflicts.

---

## FILE 2: `/home/mrnob0dy666/imsgct/ig-docs/manuscripts/opi_finite_size_convergence.tex`

**1. Central claim.** This paper argues that Decoded Quantum Interferometry (DQI) applied to Optimal Polynomial Intersection (OPI) is "the classical-logical image" of a paraconsistent Belnap-FOUR-based construction, via three legs: (a) formal Lean theorems that the classical restriction of Belnap FOUR is a coreflector/reflector pair and that the paraconsistent closure operator is inexpressible classically; (b) a hand-constructed "IMASM word" (a string of exotic Unicode glyph tokens) that is claimed to realize a "ladder" operator that is proven, term-for-term, to equal the tridiagonal matrix `A^{(m,ℓ,d)}` from Jordan et al.'s (2024) DQI/OPI paper (external arXiv source, `\cite{Jordan2024}`); and (c) numerical computation (via `opi.rs`) showing the exact finite-`m` eigenvalue converges monotonically to the known `m→p` asymptotic closed form across four scales (`p = 101, 1009, 2003, 10007`). This is a physics/CS-adjacent claim about DQI, not a pure-math theorem in the usual sense — its "proof" that `A^{(m,ℓ,d)}` is the coreflector image of the IMASM ladder (Theorem `thm:generates`) is a real, checkable linear-algebra computation with an actual displayed proof (binomial-coefficient counting argument). The value `d=(p-2r)/√(r(p-r))` is explicitly not re-derived, just imported from Jordan et al. The empirical convergence table is a genuine numerical result, though it is not independently reproducible from the manuscript alone (depends on external code `opi.rs`).

**2. Structural completeness.** Abstract states the central distinction ("Quantum mechanics is not a second reading of the Belnap/FDE structure... it is what remains once that structure is evaluated classically instead") but is dense, acronym-heavy prose written in one long sentence with embedded jargon (IMASM, DQI, OPI, FDE-trilattice) not yet defined at that point — arguably violates "state the central distinction before notation" in spirit, since undefined technical vocabulary is already load-bearing in the abstract. Numbered theorem/lemma/proposition/definition environments are used correctly (`amsthm` + `cleveref`). Critically: **Theorem `thm:inc`, Theorem `thm:coreflector`, and Theorem `thm:inexpressible` — the three central formal results of §2 — have no `\begin{proof}` at all in this document.** Their justification is entirely by parenthetical citation of Lean identifier names (e.g., "(`\texttt{inc\_always\_B}`)", "(`\texttt{centre\_coreflective\_in\_truth\_order}`)"). This is a genuine hand-wave/assert pattern: mathematical claims are stated as theorems and "proved" only by naming an external, unincluded Lean lemma. By contrast, Proposition `prop:lift` and Theorem `thm:generates` do have full in-text proofs. The paper ends with a "Discussion" and "Verification" section that functions as a status summary but does not clearly state what, if anything, remains open (e.g., whether the claimed identity extends beyond the "effective operator governing DQI's own expectation value," explicitly flagged mid-text as "not a claim about every gate of the wider circuit around it" — this caveat is not repeated in the closing sections).

**3. House-style violations — extensive.** This file is saturated with exactly the forbidden content:
- Internal file/module paths: *"Four files in `\texttt{p4ramill/Imscribing/Paraconsistent/}` carry this section... `\texttt{ParaconsistentFrobeniusClosure.lean}`, `\texttt{DeMorganBooleanCentre.lean}`, `\texttt{ClassicalRestriction.lean}`, `\texttt{FalsifiabilityDegenerate.lean}`."*
- Lean theorem/lemma identifiers cited as evidence throughout §2, e.g. *"(\texttt{inc\_always\_B})," "(\texttt{frobenius\_closure})," "(\texttt{only\_B\_is\_fixed\_point})," "(\texttt{centre\_coreflective\_in\_truth\_order})," "(\texttt{truth\_switch\_left\_adjoint\_fails})," "(\texttt{info\_inclCentre\_left\_adjoint\_fails})," "(\texttt{frobenius\_closure\_inexpressible\_classically})," "(\texttt{inc\_lands\_outside\_classical})," "(\texttt{negation\_fixpoint\_iff})," "(\texttt{B\_survives\_refutation})," "(\texttt{B\_not\_falsifiable\_to\_F})."*
